title: Person
description: A person record in the Delighted project used for survey targeting.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when the person was created.

phone_number.description: Person's phone number in E.164 format.

last_sent_at.description: Unix timestamp when the last survey was sent.

last_responded_at.description: Unix timestamp when the person last responded to a survey.

next_survey_scheduled_at.description: Unix timestamp when the next survey is scheduled to be sent.
